info.title: OpenSPP API
info.description:
The externally reachable API surface of an OpenSPP deployment. OpenSPP is a social-protection registry and programme-management platform built on Odoo, and it exposes two very different things.

1. **Odoo's external API** — RPC, not REST. `POST /xmlrpc/2/common` and `POST /xmlrpc/2/object` speak XML-RPC (Content-Type text/xml); `POST /web/session/authenticate` and `POST /jsonrpc` are the JSON equivalents. The OpenFn openspp adaptor talks to the XML-RPC pair through the `odoo-await` client: it authenticates for a uid and then routes every one of its twenty operations through a single `execute_kw` call against the OpenSPP Odoo models (res.partner, g2p.group.membership, g2p.program, g2p.program_membership, spp.service.point, spp.area). Because Odoo dispatches model methods by name at runtime, that surface is two endpoints wide and open-ended in depth — it cannot be enumerated as REST operations.

2. **OpenSPP's own REST API v2** (`spp_api_v2`, FastAPI, base path `/api/v2/spp`) — an optional but documented module family providing OAuth 2.0 protected, consent-respecting resource endpoints for Individual, Group, Program, ProgramMembership, Cycle, Entitlement, Product, ServicePoint, Vocabulary and variable Data. It addresses records by external identifier and never exposes Odoo database ids. Each deployment also serves its own generated schema at `/api/v2/spp/openapi.json`.

Both are described here so a workflow can reach either. Base URL is per deployment.

post.description: Odoo's unauthenticated `common` service. The openspp adaptor's `login` step calls `authenticate(db, login, password, {})` here through the odoo-await client and keeps the returned integer uid for every later call. Body and response are XML-RPC documents.

schema.description: XML-RPC `methodCall` document (Content-Type: text/xml). OpenAPI cannot describe XML-RPC method dispatch, so the body is carried as the raw XML document.

200.description: XML-RPC `methodResponse` document — either a `params` value or a `fault`.

post.description: Odoo's `object` service. Every openspp adaptor operation funnels through `execute_kw(db, uid, password, model, method, args, kwargs)` here: `search_read`, `search`, `create` and `write` against the models res.partner, g2p.group.membership, g2p.group.membership.kind, g2p.program, g2p.program_membership, spp.service.point and spp.area. The callable method set is open-ended — Odoo dispatches by name at runtime — so this single operation is the whole XML-RPC surface.

schema.description: XML-RPC `methodCall` document (Content-Type: text/xml). OpenAPI cannot describe XML-RPC method dispatch, so the body is carried as the raw XML document.

200.description: XML-RPC `methodResponse` document — either a `params` value or a `fault`.

post.description: JSON equivalent of the XML-RPC `authenticate` call. Same semantics, JSON bodies. Documented because the same OpenSPP/Odoo instance serves it; the adaptor itself uses the XML-RPC endpoint above.
JSON equivalent of the XML-RPC `object` service. `params.args` carries [db, uid, password, model, method, args, kwargs]. Returns the model method's result in a JSON-RPC envelope.
Exchange an API client's client_id/client_secret for a JWT bearer token used by every other API v2 call.

`spp_api_v2` is built on FastAPI and generates an OpenAPI document reflecting the modules installed on this instance.
Search individuals. The API v2 list envelope is not described in the OpenSPP documentation; it is modelled here as a bare array of the documented response fields.

bearerAuth.description: JWT issued by POST /api/v2/spp/token. The XML-RPC and JSON-RPC endpoints authenticate inside the RPC body instead.

uid.description: Authenticated user id — the `uid` passed to execute_kw.

JsonRpcRequest.description: Odoo JSON-RPC envelope for the `object` service. `params.args` is [db, uid, password, model, method, args, kwargs] — the JSON equivalent of the execute_kw call the openspp adaptor makes over XML-RPC.

args.description: [db, uid, password, model, method, args, kwargs]

JsonRpcResponse.description: JSON-RPC response envelope. `result` is whatever the dispatched model method returned: an integer id (create), a boolean (write/unlink), a list of ids (search) or a list of records (read/search_read).

result.description: Model method result; the type depends on the method dispatched.

OdooRecord.description: A generic Odoo model record as returned by read/search_read. Always carries an integer `id`; the remaining keys are whichever fields were requested.

OdooGroup.description: `res.partner` with is_registrant=true and is_group=true — a group/household registrant.

kind.description: Group kind (Household, Family, ...). Odoo many2one, serialised as [id, display_name].

area_id.description: Administrative area the group lives in. Odoo many2one, serialised as [id, display_name].

OdooIndividual.description: `res.partner` with is_registrant=true and is_group=false — an individual registrant.

area_id.description: Administrative area. Odoo many2one, serialised as [id, display_name].

OdooGroupMembership.description: `g2p.group.membership` — links an individual registrant to a group registrant.

individual.description: The individual registrant. Odoo many2one, serialised as [id, display_name].

group.description: The group registrant. Odoo many2one, serialised as [id, display_name].

OdooProgramMembership.description: `g2p.program_membership` — a registrant's enrolment in a programme.

partner_id.description: The enrolled registrant. Odoo many2one, serialised as [id, display_name].

program_id.description: The programme. Odoo many2one, serialised as [id, display_name].

area_id.description: Administrative area. Odoo many2one, serialised as [id, display_name].

OdooArea.description: `spp.area` — a node of the administrative area hierarchy.

parent_id.description: Parent area. Odoo many2one, serialised as [id, display_name].

kind.description: Area kind (Region, District, ...). Odoo many2one, serialised as [id, display_name].

TokenResponse.description: OAuth 2.0 client-credentials token response from POST /api/v2/spp/token.

Error.description: Error payload returned by the API v2 endpoints.

detail.description: Error detail; a string or a list of validation errors.

ApiExtension.description: Module-specific fields attached to an Individual or Group when the request asks for them with `?_extensions=<name>`. Keys and value types are defined per deployment by `spp.api.extension` records, so they are not fixed here.

Individual.description: An individual registrant, addressed by external identifier (never a database id).

Group.description: A group/household registrant, addressed by external identifier.

ProgramMembership.description: A registrant's enrolment in a programme.

Entitlement.description: A cash or in-kind entitlement. Cash entitlements carry `amount`/`currency`; in-kind entitlements carry `product`/`qty`/`unit`.

Product.description: A product in the in-kind catalogue.

uom_type.description: reference, bigger or smaller than reference.

ServicePoint.description: A service point (agent/shop) that delivers entitlements.

name.description: Service point name — the identifier used in lookups.

code_count.description: Number of codes in the vocabulary.

VocabularyCode.description: One code of a controlled vocabulary.

Variable.description: A variable definition available to the Data push/pull endpoints.

DataValue.description: One variable value held for a registrant.

value.description: Stored value; type depends on the variable.

DataPushRequest.description: One variable value pushed from an external system.

WriteResult.description: Acknowledgement returned by the API v2 write endpoints.
